extraction_notes: PDF identity verified from the MMBTA94 title, PNP TRANSISTORS heading, and Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology Co., Ltd. footer; catalog manufacturer string preserved exactly as hongjiacheng.
Curve points are compact manual readings from plotted traces. No interpolation between source points was used. Plotted mA, uA, mV, and pF values were converted to SI units A, V, and F.
All plotted PNP current and voltage axes retain the datasheet's negative polarity. Fig. 1 extraction uses the IB = -100 uA trace.
The plotted y-axis labels show VBE(sat) in Fig. 3 and VCE(sat) in Fig. 4, although the printed gray captions appear reversed; curve names and values follow the plotted axes.
The electrical-characteristics table gives hFE and breakdown/saturation entries as guaranteed bounds; they are retained with minimum or maximum source_kind and are not treated as typical values.

The schema has no dedicated scalar VBE(on) field; no VBE(on) table row is present. The schema also has no fields for VCBO, VEBO, ICBO, IEBO, collector-current maximum, power dissipation, or thermal resistance; these were not forced into unrelated fields.
